author: rex2630
description: Find jobs from Czech and international APIs and RSS feeds, match private user profiles, and publish localized embed alerts.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores users' job preferences, alert settings and delivery history, server sources and news settings, and normalized job listings in Red Config and a local SQLite database.
install_msg: JobFinder installed. Red requires third-party slash commands to be enabled and synced: run [p]slash enable jobset slash, [p]slash enable job slash, then [p]slash sync <server>. Use /jobset channel and select a channel from Discord's picker. Run /job preferences to edit private filters.
name: JobFinder
short: Match job listings and get private alerts.
